quote: In this paper, we propose a multi-modal Graph-of-Thought (GoT) prompting technique, as illustrated in Figure , which can be used in two distinct recommendation tasks: a general recommendation task and a multi-domain recommendation task.
We use two commonly used evaluation metrics, namely Recall@k and NDCG@k, to examine the top-k recommendation performance for both the general and multi-domain recommendation tasks.
